sentences.text: Duane Lee `` Dog '' Chapman I. -LRB- born February 2 , 1953 -RRB- is an American bounty hunter and a former bail bondsman .	bounty hunter	bounty hunter	bail bondsman	bail bondsman
He starred in a weekly reality television program called Dog the Bounty Hunter , which ran for 8 seasons until 2012 .	Dog the Bounty Hunter	Dog the Bounty Hunter
He then starred in the reality television program Dog and Beth : On the Hunt which aired from April 21 , 2013 to August 22 , 2015 .
